messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — prod: gpu-serving cluster 'prod-ray' reported sustained queue growth > 1k requests and pod scheduling failures. Autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes. @oncall please acknowledge :rotating_light:
Alex G: ack, I'm on it. hitting the cluster to pull autoscaler logs and events
Alex G: `kubectl -n infra get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 50` shows repeated errors during node create
Alex G: autoscaler logs snippet:
```
I0123 12:34:10 clusterautoscaler.go:123] Scale-up triggered: need 4 nodes
E0123 12:34:12 azure_scale.go:89] createInstance failed: UnauthorizedOperation: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/cluster-autoscaler is not authorized to perform: ec2:RunInstances
caused by role mismatch with launch template
```
Maria L: seeing same in cloudtrail — LaunchTemplateId used by ASG references a different account role. Possible regression from launch-template rotation last week.
Samir: pods are Pending with "0/12 nodes are available: 12 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu" and some "node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate"
Kevin: customer impact: high — queued generation requests for hosted API are hitting 503s and long tails, some Dedicated customers reporting dropped requests.
Alex G: starting mitigation plan: 1) scale up fallback gpu pool (older instance type, separate ASG) if possible 2) reduce throughput for best-effort tenants 3) switch some perf-critical jobs to CPU fallback models
Maria L: attempted to attach correct InstanceProfile to ASG but got `InvalidLaunchTemplate` when specifying template version — guess the template change removed required iam instance profile setting.
Alex G: trying manual ASG scale with override LT to a known-good template id: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name asg-prod-gpu-fallback --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0a1b2c3d,Version=1 --min-size 2 --desired-capacity 4`
Ops Runbook Bot: runbook suggestion -> if autoscaler cannot create instances, try manual ASG scale or detach problematic launch template. See runbook/infra/autoscaler-fallback.md
Samir: manual scale attempt returned error: `You specified an invalid launch template version. LaunchTemplateId: lt-0a1b2c3d Version: 1`
Maria L: verified that the most recent template version (v5) had a malformed `IamInstanceProfile` block due to last week's automation change. Reverting to v3 should restore assume-role permissions.
Alex G: rolling back LT to v3 for asg-prod-gpu-fallback. Applying now.
Alex G: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name asg-prod-gpu-fallback --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0a1b2c3d,Version=3 --min-size 2 --desired-capacity 4` -> accepted.
incident-bot: NOTE: manual intervention recorded by Alex G at 12:56 UTC
Samir: pods are starting to schedule on new nodes but some pods still Unschedulable: toleration missing for taint `gpu-exclusive=true:NoSchedule`
Kevin: those taints were introduced in the new node pool profile to prevent mixed workloads. Some older jobs don't set tolerations. We need a short-term admission fix.
Maria L: adding toleration automatically for our model-serving Deployment for fallback pool via `kubectl patch` to avoid restart across all pods: `kubectl -n models patch deploy model-serving -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"gpu-exclusive","operator":"Equal","value":"true","effect":"NoSchedule"}]}}}}'`
Alex G: applied patch. Observed pods reschedule and begin running. Queue length dropping from 1.2k -> 300 in next 6m.
Kevin: notifying Support and SRE pagers. Preparing customer impact note: ~15% of hosted API requests failed or timed out between 12:30-13:05 UTC, a handful of Dedicated customers hit retries.
Maria L: follow-up actions: 1) Revert automation that published v5 LT and add unit tests for IamInstanceProfile presence. 2) Validate ASG IAM perms for cluster-autoscaler role. 3) Add autoscaler alert for repeated LaunchTemplate errors.
Samir: will open linked incident ticket and assign to infra/launch-templates team.
Alex G: handing over to Maria L for post-incident follow-up and customers. I'm going to grab a quick break, will be reachable if needed.
Maria L: taking post-incident lead. @Kevin please coordinate postmortem and customer comms, include timeline and mitigation steps.
Ops Runbook Bot: suggested postmortem template: impact, timeline, root cause, mitigations, follow-ups. Use /create-incident for automated draft.
Kevin: creating postmortem doc and drafting status update for affected customers. ETA 45m.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: autoscaler errors mitigated, queue under control, fallback nodes active. Root cause: bad launch template version with missing instance profile + stricter node taints.
Alex G: thanks team. leaving detailed logs + commands run in the incident ticket.
Maria L: closing thread for now, will reopen if regressions occur. :white_check_mark:
